verdict.rationale: A probe confirms ReadMe has an official CLI (rdme) documented in its GitHub repository, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is only a single existence check, with no detail on what the CLI does or how it fits AI-native use. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and capabilities (e.g. syncing docs or OpenAPI files), AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
